original_prompt: do a laminar offsetcylinder simulation. Use PIMPLE algorithm with a generalized Newtonian model and Cross-Power-Law viscosity for momentum transport, characterized by specific parameters nuInf=10, m=0.4, n=3. Boundary conditions specify a fixed velocity of 1.5m/s at the inlet (left),fixed-value pressure of 0 at the outlet (right) with zero-gradient velocity there, and no-slip conditions for walls, including the cylinder surface. Use timestep of 0.0025 and output every 0.05. Finaltime is 0.5. use constant viscosity model with nu value of 1e-01 in physical properties. Do not use more than 1800 cells in your mesh.
adaptation: 从blockMesh补全偏置矩形与半径1圆柱，二维化去除源z厚度2m。
Cross动量输运优先于基础constant标签；基础nu解释为nu0，公开完整Cross公式，保留nuInf大于nu0的增稠参数。
保留初态、压力出口及全部壁条件；rho=1 kg/m3下静压Pa替代来源运动学压力；不迁移PIMPLE、网格上限1800或数值时间步为物理要求。
